about: Key moments for chapter 5, seeded by the project as a starting point.

jobs.prompt: Medium shot from inside a taxi driving along a highway into a sprawling city. The young man from reference image 1 and the middle-aged woman from reference image 2 sit by the window, gazing out with curiosity. Outside is a jumble of buildings of every shape and size: short and tall, stone, concrete, glass and steel, some beautiful, some ugly, a few half-built and abandoned, and small parks with neatly arranged trees. Several small passenger and cargo copters buzz across the sky. Bright daytime light.

Wide interior view of a large institute building whose floor is a single gently sloping spiral ramp, looping around several times beneath a high ceiling, with elevators and staircases in the open center. The young man from reference image 1 and the young woman from reference image 2 stroll leisurely along the outer wall, looking around with interest. Further along the ramp is a small restaurant with tables, and a large wall screen showing soft abstract colored shapes. Clean modern materials, cool natural light.

Medium shot at a restaurant table on the spiral ramp of a modern institute building. The woman from reference image 1 and the man from reference image 2 sit with cups of tea and plates of rice and vegetables, both frozen in surprise, staring across the table. Opposite them, seen from behind, sit a teenage boy who is talking nonchalantly and a teenage girl leaning toward him. A small service robot waits at the side of the table. Soft daylight, a modern interior of glass and concrete.

Close-medium shot of the woman from reference image 1 sitting alone at a cafe table in a modern building, a half-finished cup of tea and an empty plate in front of her. She holds up her wrist and smiles warmly at her watch, where a small glowing video image shows the face of the man from reference image 2. Behind her curves the gently sloping ramp of the building, with a few distant diners. Afternoon light through tall windows, glass and concrete surroundings.
